task.summary: Add a fail-closed MONAI Deploy text safety gate before downstream narrative publication.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a standard-library Python client with strict response validation, bounded requests, bounded timeouts, and privacy-safe errors.
Add a MONAI Deploy Operator that forwards narrative text only after a consistent PASS decision and fails closed otherwise.
Restrict plain HTTP to loopback by default and document trusted HTTPS deployment boundaries.
Add deterministic synthetic unit tests using local stubs and a loopback fake HTTP service.
Document accurate DICOM Text SR wiring, compatibility limits, privacy boundaries, and MONAI non-affiliation in English and Chinese.
Run integration tests in CI, preserve existing checks, and obtain independent AI review.

scope.description: Fail-closed MONAI Deploy adapter, strict HTTP client, synthetic regression tests, bilingual integration guidance, CI coverage, and project documentation.

tests.command: start packaged Java service on loopback and evaluate synthetic PASS and BLOCK cases through the Python client
compare adapter and wiring with MONAI Deploy App SDK 3.0.0 and current public Operator sources
